comment: Packages with zero internal, non-test callers, declared on purpose. check_orphan_packages.py fails on any orphan package missing here, or on a stale entry: one whose package no longer exists, or one that has gained a real caller. permanent=false means an internal caller is expected later, named in target. permanent=true means this package is a composition root or a test-only fixture, consumed only by application code outside this module or only from another package's _test directory, and target names that consumer.

a2aclient.reason: A2A v1.0 client and, since Phase 86's a2aack fold, the remote step ack adapter. Its only internal caller was a2aack, which the fold merged into it; a2aloopback is a test fixture. The sibling consumer repo had zero references to a2aclient at fold time. Kept as SDK surface.
a2aclient.target: no internal consumer today; kept as SDK surface

a2aclient/a2atest.reason: Test-only fixture. AGENTS.md's a2aclient entry calls it 'the loopback test fixture,' imported only from a2aclient's own _test files, which this scan excludes.

agentloop.reason: Model-driven composition root: a tool-calling loop over a provider.Completer and a tools.Registry, meant to be imported by application code. docs/examples/_quickstart, docs/examples/_agentloop, and docs/examples/_agentloop_adoption are its in-repo positive controls, and verify-fast runs all three.
agentloop.target: application code that imports this module

dispatch.reason: NDJSON envelope HTTP endpoint. No consumer today: the sibling consumer repo has zero references to it as of 2026-09-07; it ships its own HTTP wiring. Kept as SDK surface.
dispatch.target: no consumer today; kept as SDK surface

internal/e2e.reason: End-to-end scenario harness. Its intended callers are its own e2e_test subdirectory and subagent/subagent_test/helpers_test.go, both test code, by design.

ledger/ledgertest.reason: Test-only conformance kit, formerly the top-level durablefence package. It is imported only from other packages' _test subdirectories.
ledger/ledgertest.target: ledger/ledger_test and other packages' _test subdirectories only

mcp.reason: MCP client leaf. Its consumer is external application code: the sibling consumer repo imports it through internal/sdkadapter as of 2026-09-07.
mcp.target: external application code (the sibling consumer repo)

provider/anthropic.reason: Anthropic Messages API adapter leaf. No external consumer today: the sibling consumer repo has zero references to it as of 2026-09-07; it ships its own internal/provider/anthropic.go. In-repo callers are the e2e wire test and the agentloop composition example.
provider/anthropic.target: no external consumer today; in-repo callers are the e2e wire test and the agentloop composition example

subagent.reason: Blocks-as-tools composition: spawnable subagents, concurrent RunAll, and mailboxes. Its last internal caller was runconfig, which Phase 86 quarantined into the x/ sub-module; x/runconfig still imports it across the module boundary, and the sibling consumer repo composes it directly. Declared so the orphan gate reflects that.
subagent.target: the x/runconfig quarantine package and external application code

workspace.reason: Filesystem confinement leaf. Its only internal caller was subagent's file-editing toolbox (FileTools, WorkspaceReadTool, WorkspaceWriteTool, WorkspaceListTool, WorkspaceStatTool, DiffTool), removed as coding-agent product surface; see docs/plans/agents/convergence.md's 'Boundary correction' section. No internal caller remains. Phase 86 folded its secretpath dependency into it, so a future consumer takes one package.
